findings.title: A valid, data-preserving v3 domain change is rewritten into DROP COLUMN, destroying encrypted data
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The strict regex keys only on the eql_v3_* target, and renderSafeAlter always emits ADD/DROP/RENAME. A jsonb or v3-domain source change that may have been castable is therefore turned into a column drop, and the tests have no such source case.

findings.title: Plaintext→v3 migration on a populated table now runs and drops the plaintext instead of failing
findings.label: valid
findings.note: renderSafeAlter has no row-count guard, and the change extends the destructive rewrite to v3 targets and the v3 migration command. SKILL.md documents empty-table-only safety but nothing enforces it.

findings.title: Already-applied v3 migrations are rewritten on disk, so fresh environments get a different schema from production
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The v3 eql migration path now sweeps all sibling files with no journal check, so applied v3 migrations can be rewritten and fresh environments diverge from production.
